info.name: Emarsys Core API - Sections endpoint batch
List Sections in a Template-based Email Campaign

params.name: emailId
params.description: The identifier of the email campaign.

items.docs: Returns a list of sections used in the specified template-based email campaign.

info.name: Create a Section in a Template-based Email Campaign

params.name: emailId
params.description: The identifier of the email campaign.

items.docs: Adds a new section to a template-based email campaign with the specified parameters.

info.name: Get a Section of a Template-based Email Campaign

params.name: emailId
params.description: The identifier of the email campaign.

items.docs: Returns the details of a section of a template-based email campaign.

info.name: Update a Section of a Template-based Email Campaign

params.name: emailId
params.description: The identifier of the email campaign.

items.docs: Updates a content section of a template-based email campaign using the specified parameters.

info.name: Delete a Section from a Template-based Email Campaign

params.name: emailId
params.description: The identifier of the email campaign.

items.docs: Deletes a section from a template-based email campaign.
